thinking.note: Gemini thinking level per role; unlisted roles use the model's default. Low halved recommendation latency (12.3 s to 6.1 s median) with the same eval result.

ollama.note: numCtx caps the context window. Some models default to 256K, which makes Ollama reserve more memory than a 16 GB GPU has and crash.

gemini:gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: Paid tier (standard), checked 2026-09-30. The free tier costs nothing.

gemini:gemini-3.8-flash.note: Paid tier through 2026-12-31; rises to 1.50 / 7.50 on 2027-01-01. The free tier costs nothing.
